children: Greece tanker operator's Q2 2026 revenue rose 54% yr/yr, net income surged over 500%
Company paid $1.50 per share in common stock dividends for 2026
Q2 results driven by strong tanker market and capital gains from vessel sales
Company says tanker market fundamentals remain strong
Company expects favorable geopolitical developments to support sustained healthy market
Company intends to announce first semi-annual dividend payment for 2027 in November 2026
HIGHER TCE RATES - Co said average TCE per vessel per day rose 50% yr/yr in Q2, supported by strong tanker market fundamentals and high fleet utilization
VESSEL SALES - Net income included $38 mln in capital gains from vessel sales in Q2
LOWER INTEREST COSTS - Interest and finance costs fell by $2.3 mln yr/yr in Q2 due to lower borrowing spreads and global interest rates
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the oil & gas transportation services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Tsakos Energy Navigation Ltd is $42.00, about 5.2% below its September 9 closing price of $44.32
The stock recently traded at 9 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 5 three months ago
